textbookText: Incubation period for this disease is about 12 days in average. Pre-patent period is about 5 days due to the absence of exo-erythocytic schizogony. In the signet ring stage, a small ring is situated at the edge of RBC with two chromatin dots. Trophozoite is small as compared to that of Plasmodium vivax and sometimes there are two trophozoites in one RBC. Schizont is very small measuring 5 µ diameter. Haemozoin is black coloured and RBCs are not enlarged but get shrinked and greenish coloured. No schuffners dots are seen but maure’s dots are found in RBC. Schizonts in RBC form 8-36 merozoites which are not seen in peripheral blood and gametocytes are crescentic shaped.
Comparative study of four species of Plasmodium infecting human beings.
